name: FlightResultCard
description: One flight option in the results list: segments, aircraft, from-price, and the expandable fare options.

evidence: Props, composition and a composition example documented; no dedicated states section.

provenance.tag: A · unverified. No official spec exists (Official research: "cannot verify any official spec for flight cards").

props.name: segments
props.description: One or more segments (flights) in this journey, with connections.

props.name: fromPrice
props.description: Lowest fare, from the offer data.

interaction: Choosing a fare dispatches SELECT_FARE { journeyId, offerId, fareId }; the chosen fare card shows "Selected" text plus the selected border and check icon instead of the Choose button.

requirements: The card is an article named by a summary (e.g. "Emirates EK1, Dubai to London, 08:40").
The outer card is not interactive: it contains its own buttons, and an interactive card wrapping other controls would nest interactive elements.
Choose buttons are actions with a specific name ("Choose Economy Flex, USD 899"), not aria-pressed toggles.

responsive.behavior: Stacked vertically; fare options open below the card.

rules: All prices come from the offer data returned by the server.
Column gap --space-6; time → IATA → city stack gap --space-1; card → fare matrix gap --space-4.

ambiguities.description: inventory.md lists "Card interactive" in the composition, but tier-2-composites.md (later decision) says the outer card is NOT interactive because it contains buttons. The non-interactive version is the current rule.
